schema:
CREATE TABLE address (
  address,
  address2,
  address_id,
  city_id,
  district,
  last_update,
  phone,
  postal_code
);

CREATE TABLE customer (
  active,
  address_id,
  create_date,
  customer_id,
  email,
  first_name,
  last_name,
  last_update,
  store_id
);

CREATE TABLE film (
  description,
  film_id,
  language_id,
  last_update,
  length,
  original_language_id,
  rating,
  release_year,
  rental_duration,
  rental_rate,
  replacement_cost,
  special_features,
  title
);

CREATE TABLE payment (
  amount,
  customer_id,
  last_update,
  payment_date,
  payment_id,
  rental_id,
  staff_id
);

CREATE TABLE rental (
  customer_id,
  inventory_id,
  last_update,
  rental_date,
  rental_id,
  return_date,
  staff_id
);

CREATE TABLE staff (
  active,
  address_id,
  email,
  first_name,
  last_name,
  last_update,
  password,
  picture,
  staff_id,
  store_id,
  username
);
